sleep_landing_hero.heading: The Sleep Reset Course
sleep_landing_hero.subheading: A free 10-week course to reset your sleep, calm your mind, and rebuild your rhythm.
sleep_landing_hero.background_image_alt: Bedside lamp and bed used as the Sleep Reset Course hero background

sleep_landing_intro.paragraph: If sleep has started to feel frustrating, unpredictable, or hard to trust, this free class can help you rebuild a more steady foundation.
Using evidence-based Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) principles, this free course helps you develop the patterns that make sleep more likely to happen naturally.
Together, we'll work on strengthening your sleep system, reducing the patterns that keep your body stuck in wakefulness, and creating conditions that make sleep feel more accessible again.

sleep_landing_goals.heading: The goal is to help you...

bullets.text: Improve sleep continuity so you stay asleep longer
Lower the stress and pressure that can keep you trapped in unhelpful patterns
Rebuild confidence in your natural sleep system

sleep_landing_goals.closing_copy: Everything is broken down into small, manageable steps so it feels doable, even if you're already feeling tired, discouraged, or overwhelmed.
sleep_landing_goals.course_summary: This free 10-week course walks you through the key foundations of healthy sleep, from understanding how sleep works and stabilizing your rhythm, to reducing nighttime activation and building long-term confidence. Each week builds on the last to support more consistent, restful sleep.

sleep_landing_curriculum.preamble: If you'd like to see how the program is structured, you can review the full curriculum below.
sleep_landing_curriculum.heading: Complete 10-Week Curriculum Overview
sleep_landing_curriculum.intro: This program is designed to strengthen your sleep system, reduce nighttime alertness, and rebuild long-term confidence in your ability to sleep.

weeks.title: Understand Your Sleep
weeks.description: Learn how sleep works and why insomnia persists. Begin simple sleep tracking to build awareness without overanalyzing patterns.

weeks.title: Anchor Your Wake Time & Rhythm
weeks.description: Establish a consistent wake time to stabilize your rhythm and rebuild sleep pressure. Reduce naps if needed, understand why bedtime may temporarily shift later, and make your bed a stronger cue for sleep.

weeks.title: Check for Sleep Apnea and Other Contributors
weeks.description: Take a closer look at potential underlying factors that may be affecting your sleep. Learn when it's helpful to explore things like sleep apnea or other contributors, and how to approach this in a way that feels informed and supportive, not overwhelming.

weeks.title: Strengthen Your Sleep Window
weeks.description: Learn why going to bed earlier can backfire and how time in bed affects your sleep. Begin shaping a sleep window that supports deeper, more consistent rest.

weeks.title: Calm Nighttime Activation
weeks.description: Reduce panic and hyperarousal when you wake at night. Understand how stress and alertness show up in the body, and learn how to respond in a way that supports returning to sleep.

weeks.title: Build Sleep Confidence
weeks.description: Shift your relationship with sleep from fear to trust. Reduce anticipatory anxiety, let go of perfectionism, and learn to experience wakefulness without reinforcing the fear loop.

weeks.title: Support Your Nervous System Stability
weeks.description: Address the tired-but-wired pattern and reduce overall system activation. Build consistent pre-bed transitions and support your sleep through daytime signals like light, movement, and engagement.

weeks.title: Reduce Sleep Effort and Let Go
weeks.description: Address the sleep effort trap. Reduce monitoring and subtle control behaviors. Shift from performance-based sleep to confidence-based sleep.

weeks.title: Stabilize Your Nights
weeks.description: Focus on building consistency and reinforcing the changes you've made. Learn how to navigate natural ups and downs in your sleep without losing confidence, and begin creating a more steady, reliable pattern night to night.

weeks.title: Maintain Your Sleep Long-Term
weeks.description: Create a personalized plan for travel, illness, stress, and schedule changes. Identify anchors, warning signs, and reset strategies for lasting stability.

sleep_landing_final_cta.heading: Ready to Get Started?
sleep_landing_final_cta.copy: Choose the support option that feels best for you, and we'll help you take the next steps toward more consistent, restorative sleep.
